lowRatings.text:
Extremely disappointing tour. Very rough ride in a van too small for 12 passengers. Could barely move inside the van and the air conditioning did not work. It was hot and very dusty. The so called snacks were 1 bottle of warm water and a small bag of chips , a granola bar and a a small protein bar.
Our guide was very nice but uncomfortable with the situation of overcrowding and lack of air conditioning. Also the trip was 3 hours longer than we were told.  I would not recommend this tour.
